# Design point P024

## Description

The system maintains a normal Git repository on fast local NVMe storage to synchronize reference transactions, while operators explicitly invoke individual or complete maintenance tasks when needed. It does not adopt a Git-level repository-access redesign for hosting scale-out, so these mechanisms operate without that proposed integration change.
